name: serena
description: Semantic code navigation, editing, refactoring, and project memories with Serena. Requires uvx to be available on the host.

interface.longDescription: Serena provides semantic code navigation, editing, refactoring, and project memories for coding agents. Runs locally through uvx with Python 3.13 and the latest serena-agent release from PyPI, using the Codex context and automatic project detection.
interface.defaultPrompt: Activate the current project with Serena and read its initial instructions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of the Serena OpenAI Plugin.
